models.zdr: Z.ai Data Processing Addendum for API Services (in Privacy Policy, Last Update: September 29, 2025) §4(b): 'The Company do not store any of the content the Customer or its End Users provide or generate while using our Services... processed in real-time ... and is not saved on our servers.' §4(c): other Customer Data stored temporarily and deleted after termination. No-storage of API content is the policy default; no separate ZDR opt-in or contract is described. Consumer side: 'retain personal data for as long as it is needed'. Terms of Use (April 14, 2026): User Content used to improve Services 'For individual users'
models.training_tokens: family summary: 'More than 10 trillions tokens' (text); GLM-5 report: 28.5T tokens for GLM-5 (pp3-4). No GLM-5.3-specific figure
